rules.detail: footprint inside envelope, front-aligned and centred; every clear rectangle is 250 mm inside the outside face
no room, flex or hallway rectangle overlaps another room or flex rectangle
all 11 required rooms present; omissions disclosed: none
every room within catalog min/max (sorted sides) and aspect limit
exterior band 250, interior bands 100, clear rectangles separated by at least a wall thickness
every cell inside the exterior wall is a room, hallway, flex patch or wall band
14 openings, each >= 820 clear, inside a wall band and spanning the two spaces it joins
every door joins spaces the tiers permit (Bedroom/Bathroom/WC: hallway only; WIR: Master/Ensuite; Ensuite: WIR/Master; Pantry: Core; ...)
every room and flex patch has a permitted door
Entry and Garage vehicle opening are on the front edge; front door present
every room, flex patch and hallway segment is reachable from Entry
no private room (Master, Bedroom, Bathroom, WC, Garage, Ensuite, WIR) is a through-route except Master->Ensuite/WIR and WIR->Ensuite
no Family Core carries circulation between hallway pieces
every hallway segment is at least 1000 clear
